lines.text: Keep the receipt, model and serial, coverage details and claim route together, then check what is covered before authorizing a repair.

items.text: Photograph the full rating plate and record the exact model and serial.
Save the receipt, order confirmation, delivery and installation evidence available.
Download the warranty version applying to the purchase rather than relying on a current marketing page.
Record what event starts each coverage period.
Separate component, parts and labor periods and any stated limits.
Note registration status, transfer rules and documented maintenance requirements actually found in the terms.

line.text: Make, model, install date, warranty end and the what-to-buy line live on the thing itself, and print onto one card when you need them.
